questions.q: Where did Yahweh tell Moses and Aaron for the tribes to put their tents?
questions.a: Yahweh told the tribes to put their tents around the banner of their armed group and around a smaller flag indicating their tribe. Their camps were to face the tent of meeting.

questions.q: Where did Moses say the 74,600 men of the army of the tribe of Judah must camp, and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp around Judah’s banner to the east of the tent of meeting where the sun rises, and that Nahshon must lead their army.

questions.q: Where must the 54,400 men of the tribe of Issachar camp, and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp next to Judah, and Nethanel must lead the army.

questions.q: Where must the 57,400 men of the tribe of Zebulun camp and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp next to Issachar, and Eliab must lead the army.

questions.q: Who is to go first out of the camp?
questions.a: All the armies that camp with Judah would go first out of the camp.

questions.q: Where must the 46,500 men of the tribe of Reuben camp, and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp around the banner of Rueben on the south side, and Elizur must lead the army.

questions.q: Where must the 59,300 men of the tribe of Simeon camp, and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp next to Reuben, and Shelumiel must lead their army.

questions.q: Where must the 45,650 men of the tribe of Gad camp, and who must lead their army?
questions.a: They must camp next, and Eliasaph must lead their army.

questions.q: Who is to go second out of the camp?
questions.a: All the armies that camp together with Reuben must go out second.

questions.q: How many people were numbered in the camp of Ephraim?
questions.a: There were 108,100 people numbered in the camp of Ephraim.

questions.q: When was the camp of Ephraim supposed to set out in relation to the other camps?
questions.a: The camp of Ephraim was supposed to set out third.

questions.q: Who was the leader of the people of Dan?
questions.a: The leader of the people of Dan was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

questions.q: Whom did Moses and Aaron not count among the people of Israel and why?
questions.a: Moses did not count the Levites among the people of Israel because this was as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

questions.q: What did the people of Israel do?
questions.a: The people of Israel did everything that Yahweh commanded Moses—camped by their banners and went out from camp by their clans in the order of their ancestor’s families.

commentary.text: The order of the tribes in their tents.

—The tribes were to encamp about the tabernacle, which was to be in the midst of them. It was a token of God's gracious presence. Yet they were to pitch their tents afar off, in reverence to the sanctuary. The children of Israel put themselves in their posts, without murmuring or disputing; and as it was their safety, so it was their beauty. It is our duty and interest to be contented with the place allotted to us, and to endeavour to occupy it in a proper manner, without envying or murmuring; without ambition or covetousness. Thus the gospel church ought to be compact, according to the Scripture model, every one knowing and keeping his place; and then all that wish well to the church rejoice, beholding their order, Col 2:5.
